title: APEXFIN quality expectations
description: Per-source and per-symbol thresholds the six quality checks measure against. Every threshold here encodes a judgement about a specific dataset; a fork must be able to change all of them without touching Python. The `defaults` block is mandatory and every numeric key in it must be explicit -- the load path raises ConfigError when one is missing (O-09).

defaults.description: Applied to any source that omits a key. Defaults exist to keep the file short, not to excuse an undeclared source: a series with no entry under `sources` is a load-time error (O-09).

frequency.description: Expected publication cadence. Drives which calendar days the completeness and continuity checks require.

max_lag_trading_days.description: How many TRADING days the latest event may lag today before the freshness check fires. Trading days are the only unit in this file (O-07); there is deliberately no hour-based key, and adding one would put two incompatible units on the same dashboard.

completeness_window_days.description: Length of the trailing window the completeness check counts observations in. Zero disables the window.

max_missing_trading_days.description: How many trading days inside the completeness window may have no observation.

max_gap_trading_days.description: Longest run of consecutive missing trading days the continuity check tolerates. Distinct from max_missing: twenty scattered holes and one twenty-day blackout are different failures.

expects_secondary.description: Whether value_secondary (volume, for an OHLCV series) must be present. Feeds the completeness factor of quality_score.

value_min.description: Lower bound for the range check. Null means unbounded. A price series should set 0 here so a negative close is caught rather than charted.

value_max.description: Upper bound for the range check. Null means unbounded.

sources.description: Keyed by source name, matching `name` in sources.yaml. Every key maps to a source_entry; a configured series whose source is absent here is a load-time error (O-09).

symbols.description: Per-symbol overrides, keyed by symbol id. Each value is the same shape as a source_entry and overrides the source-level values.
